method.possession: Same-team passes and loose-ball intervals retain possession until an opposing controlled touch or restart. Restart/halftime breaks do not count as open-play regains.
method.rapidLoss: A regained team loses the next controlled possession within2 simulation seconds; no result or tackle is reclassified.
method.space: Every1 simulation second only when open play has an active carrier; outfield width/depth/goal-side for both teams, support for carrier team. Forward support is geometric2–25m and >1m forward, not an unmarked passing-lane claim.
method.interpretation: Read-only diagnostics, not population balance or professional match-stat calibration. Fixed coaching is diagnostic; adaptive is actual T.coach team1 only, not complete campaign45/65-minute plans.

limits: Two reused seeds across eight conditions; not512 independent population samples.
Fixed and adaptive cases can have identical complete worlds; retain all conditions and report unique hashes.
Open-play regains include interceptions, tackles and goalkeeper control changes; they are not successful-tackle statistics.
Possession spans same-team passes and loose-ball intervals and closes on opponent control, restart, halftime or finish. End-of-period censoring is not corrected.
Spacing samples only active controlled open play every1s. Nearest support excludes keepers; forward support is geometry and can include marked or offside players.
Some styles/formation preferences remain; these measurements do not alter published1–14 physics or relabel match facts.
